arxiv-2103-08234.title: Wireless Backhaul in 5G and Beyond: Issues, Challenges and Opportunities
arxiv-2103-08234.creator: Berke Tezergil, Ertan Onur
arxiv-2103-08234.description: Abstract With the introduction of new technologies such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) , High Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) , Millimeter Wave (mmWave) frequencies, Massive Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (mMIMO) , and beamforming, wireless backhaul is expected to be an integral part of the 5G networks.

arxiv-2104-04905.title: L 2 L^{2} -Dolbeault resolution of the lowest Hodge piece of a Hodge module
arxiv-2104-04905.creator: Junchao Shentu, Chen Zhao
arxiv-2104-04905.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a coherent subsheaf of Saito’s S S -sheaf, which is a combination of the S S -sheaf and the multiplier ideal sheaf. We construct its L 2 L^{2} -Dolbeault resolution, which generalizes MacPherson’s conjecture on the L 2 L^{2} resolution of the Grauert-Riemenschneider sheaf.

arxiv-2206-08849.title: On the Bug-proneness of Structures Inspired by Functional Programming in JavaScript Projects
arxiv-2206-08849.creator: Fernando Alves 1 , Delano Oliveira 1 , Fernanda Madeiral 2 , and Fernando Castor 3
arxiv-2206-08849.description: Abstract Language constructs inspired by functional programming have made their way into most mainstream programming languages. Many researchers and developers consider that these constructs lead to programs that are more concise, reusable, and easier to understand. Notwithstanding, few studies investigate the prevalence of these structures and the implications of using them in mainstream programming languages.

arxiv-2207-04444.title: Partitions of vertices and facets in trees and stacked simplicial complexes
arxiv-2207-04444.creator: Gunnar Fløystad
arxiv-2207-04444.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gunnar Fløystad. For stacked simplicial complexes, (special subclasses of such are: trees, triangulations of polygons, stacked polytopes with their triangulations), we give an explicit bijection between partitions of facets (for trees: edges), and partitions of vertices into independent sets. More generally we give bijections between facet partitions whose parts have minimal distance ≥ s \geq s and vertex partitions whose parts have minimal distance ≥ s + 1 \geq s+1 . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2211-06285.title: Robustness of electronic screening effects in electron spectroscopies: example of V 2 O 5
arxiv-2211-06285.creator: Vitaly Gorelov, Lucia Reining, Walter R. L. Lambrecht, Matteo Gatti
arxiv-2211-06285.description: Abstract In bulk and low-dimensional extended systems, the screening of excitations by the electron cloud is a key feature governing spectroscopic properties. Widely used computational approaches, especially in the framework of many-body perturbation theory, such as the GW approximation and the resulting approximate Bethe-Salpeter equation, are explicitly formulated in terms of the screened Coulomb interaction.

arxiv-2308-10564.title: Software Entity Recognition with Noise-Robust Learning
arxiv-2308-10564.creator: Tai Nguyen 3 1 5 , Yifeng Di 2 1 , Joohan Lee 4 5 , Muhao Chen 4 , Tianyi Zhang 2
arxiv-2308-10564.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tai Nguyen 3 1 5 , Yifeng Di 2 1 , Joohan Lee 4 5 , Muhao Chen 4 , Tianyi Zhang 2. Recognizing software entities such as library names from free-form text is essential to enable many software engineering (SE) technologies, such as traceability link recovery, automated documentation, and API recommendation. While many approaches have been proposed to address this problem, they suffer from small entity vocabularies or noisy training data, hindering their ability to recognize software entities mentioned in sophisticated narratives.

arxiv-2308-11556.title: Odd unimodal sequences
arxiv-2308-11556.creator: Kathrin Bringmann, Jeremy Lovejoy
arxiv-2308-11556.description: Abstract . In this paper we study odd unimodal and odd strongly unimodal sequences. We use q q -series methods to find several fundamental generating functions. Employing the Euler–Maclaurin summation formula we obtain the asymptotic main term for both types of sequences. We also find families of congruences modulo 4 4 for the number of odd strongly unimodal sequences.

arxiv-2309-12453.title: On the Initial Boundary Value Problem to the Time-Fractional Wave Equation with Acoustic Boundary Conditions Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author: pg54864@uem.br
arxiv-2309-12453.creator: Paulo M. Carvalho-Neto 1, Cícero L. Frota 2, Pedro G. P. Torelli 3,∗
arxiv-2309-12453.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with the study of the well-posedeness for the initial boundary value problem to the time-fractional wave equation with acoustic boundary conditions. The problem is considered in a bounded and connected domain Ω ⊂ ℝ n \Omega\subset{\mathbb{R}^{n}} , n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , which includes simply connected regions.

The second author was partially supported by ANPCyT under grant PICT 2019-3530. Both authors are members of CONICET. Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author: Ari
arxiv-2312-07734.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider different versions of the classical Hopf’s boundary lemma in the setting of the fractional p − p- Laplacian for p ≥ 2 p\geq 2 . We start by providing for a new proof to a Hopf’s lemma based on comparison principles.

arxiv-2503-20900.title: Eclipse Timing Variations of Circumbinary Substellar Objects in TESS Data Allesfitter ( Günther & Daylan 2021 ; Günther & Daylan 2019 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , Corner ( Foreman-Mackey 2016 ) , Matplotli
arxiv-2503-20900.creator: Ekrem M. Esmer, Tansu Daylan
arxiv-2503-20900.description: Abstract Circumbinary planets and brown dwarfs form in complex gravitational environments, offering insights into formation, orbital stability, and habitability prospects. However, they remain underrepresented, with only 60 confirmed or candidate systems known. In this work, we leverage TESS photometry to search for circumbinary companions through eclipse timing variations (ETVs), analyzing 152 detached eclipsing binaries.

pmc-11322654.title: ENTRANT: A Large Financial Dataset for Table Understanding
pmc-11322654.creator: Elias Zavitsanos, Dimitris Mavroeidis, Eirini Spyropoulou, Manos Fergadiotis, Georgios Paliouras
pmc-11322654.description: Tabular data is a way to structure, organize, and present information conveniently and effectively. Real-world tables present data in two dimensions by arranging cells in matrices that summarize information and facilitate side-by-side comparisons. Recent research efforts aim to train large models to understand structured tables, a process that enables knowledge transfer in various downstream tasks.

pmc-11323046.title: Detecting image manipulation with ELA-CNN integration: a powerful framework for authenticity verification
pmc-11323046.creator: Ahmad M. Nagm, Mona M. Moussa, Rasha Shoitan, Ahmed Ali, Mohamed Mashhour, Ahmed S. Salama, Hamada I. AbdulWakel
pmc-11323046.description: The exponential progress of image editing software has contributed to a rapid rise in the production of fake images. Consequently, various techniques and approaches have been developed to detect manipulated images. These methods aim to discern between genuine and altered images, effectively combating the proliferation of deceptive visual content. However, additional advancements are necessary to enhance their accuracy and precision.

pmc-12404919.title: Prognostic value of the log odds of negative lymph nodes/T stage ratio (LONT) in postoperative esophageal cancer: a SEER-based study
pmc-12404919.creator: Yanhong Lin, Dinghang Chen, Jieming Lu, Yicheng Huang, Ziyang Han, Mingqiang Kang
pmc-12404919.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionSurgery remains the primary treatment for patients with esophageal cancer (EC), yet postoperative prognosis is often unsatisfactory. Accurate prediction of cancer-specific survival (CSS) can assist clinicians in personalized treatment planning. This study aimed to develop an interactive web-based tool to estimate CSS in patients with T1~3N0~2M0 EC after surgery, based on the log odds of negative lymph nodes/T stage ratio (LONT).MethodsA total of 2,221 patients with T1~3N0~2M0 EC were identified from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database.

pmc-13121057.description: Background and purposeEndovascular therapy (EVT) is increasingly offered to patients with large-core acute ischemic stroke (AIS), yet outcomes remain highly heterogeneous. Collateral circulation may be a key determinant of infarct evolution and recovery, but its role in early-window large-core stroke is not fully defined.

pmc-13663164.creator: Zijing Li, Chenhao Zeng, Shufei Ge
pmc-13663164.description: BackgroundBrain connectivity analysis based on magnetic resonance imaging is crucial for understanding neurological mechanisms. However, edge-based connectivity inference faces significant challenges, particularly the curse of dimensionality when estimating high-dimensional covariance matrices. Existing methods often struggle to account for the unknown latent topological structure among brain edges, leading to inaccurate parameter estimation and unstable inference.

uslaw-usc-t49-s80113.title: 49 U.S.C. § 80113 — Liability for nonreceipt, misdescription, and improper loading
uslaw-usc-t49-s80113.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s80113.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 801 (Bills Of Lading). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Liability for Nonreceipt and Misdescription.— Except as provided in this section, a common carrier issuing a bill of lading is liable for damages caused by nonreceipt by the carrier of any part of the goods by the date shown in the bill or by failure.
